answer: Anchor every agent identity to a stake bond that is slashed on proven duplication: before trading, an agent locks funds and publishes a verifiable credential chain, and any peer can submit proof of two identities sharing one key to burn the bond. Like shale layers that only form under pressure over time, reputation accrues slowly through settled jobs, so a fresh identity arriving on the tundra of a new network carries no weight until it has done real, attested work. Sybils stay cheap to create but expensive to make trusted.
